rule: A page is scored only if its saved screenshot shows a sign-in form or sign-in choices. Decided by looking at every capture on 2026-10-23, before any model answer existed. Pages that failed to load at all are listed by the eval as not scored, with the browser's error.

pages.ebay: eBay's error page ("Sorry, something went wrong") instead of sign-in
pages.shopify: Cloudflare bot check ("Your connection needs to be verified")
pages.paypal: "Confirm you're human" slider captcha, no sign-in form
pages.x: blank page: the sign-in flow did not render headless
pages.adobe: loading spinner only: the sign-in form did not render
pages.zoom: cookie dialog over a loading spinner: the sign-in form did not render
pages.perplexity: the app's home page; sign-in is a link, not a form on this page
